items.text: Star Trucker has been updated to v1.75.2
This hotfix update resolves two issues that could prevent game progression alongside some other important fixes. We thank you for your patience.
Dave & Dan ( aka Monster and Monster )
Fixed issue with a soft-lock during auto-save that could occur due to Lost Mail jobs being available
Fixed issue with player truck being unable to detach from docking bays
Fixed issue with debris initialization potentially causing collisions during warp
Fixed issue with location indicators enabling too early during “Junk in the Trunk”
Fixed issue with cargo capsules not appearing inside diamond frame trailers
Fixed issue with a small number of drop zones not being large enough for eco trailers
Fixed issue with some dash items being removed when reloading a save
Fixed issue with upcoming seasonal hologram
Below are some issues we are currently investigating for future updates…
Space Station POIs not inheriting Courier Job names when active - FIX IN PROGRESS
Some trade items not appearing as frequently as expected in shops - FIX IN PROGRESS
Courier POIs can occasionally vanish until you reload or re-enter a sector - FIX IN PROGRESS
Some peripheral setups being incompatible with the game - INVESTIGATIONS ONGOING
Howdy all!
We’re celebrating 2 incredible years of Star Truckin’ with a chunky new update! Check out the mini-trailer below for a quick preview!
For a no-frills list of changes, head on over to the latest changelog. Otherwise read on for a more detailed summary of what you can find in the Plants & Post update!
Let’s jump straight in with the important stuff. Alongside a smorgasbord of tweaks and improvements this update also features TWO new business ventures for you to unlock and enjoy.
SPECIALIST COURIER is a FREE unlock and introduces a range of jobs themed around mail alongside a range of fantastic new customization rewards.
CULTIVATION EXPERT is a PREMIUM venture that can be unlocked as part of the new Cultivation Content Pack. This DLC unlocks a new set of jobs, rewards PLUS unique new trailers and cargo to haul.
Read on for a full rundown of new content alongside a ton of images taken directly from the update 📸
Once you have the update, the new postal themed business venture can be accessed shortly after unlocking Zone 2 or 3.
It’s worth noting that you’ll need to wait 1h of in-game time ( or jump to a nearby sector ) to trigger the first interaction but then you’ll be good to go!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/849500df32bf72a9acf68b68ad8230e18599bc28.gif"]

Once unlocked you’ll be contacted by Ricardo from the Galactic Postal Service. He’s a fellow courier, voiced by the talented Dre Ayala, and will provide audio cues for different jobs while keeping you updated (whether you like it or not) on his chosen career path…
As with the Galactic Handyman you’ll start with 1 job slot that can be upgraded by purchasing venture boosts using in-game currency.
The available jobs include…
DELIVERY ROUND
Collect mail from a collection point and deliver it to multiple mailboxes within the sector. Mail includes bundles of letters, magazines and newspapers.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/87e70262c21b3b2f9fdf78c2461ae4a5780af158.jpg"]
LOST & FOUND
Head the last known location of a missing mail pod. Collect the mail sacks and deliver them to a nearby drop-off point.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/0cdedde97423533a2075e5bc319859aafcf81a35.jpg"]
SPECIAL DELIVERY
Collect a package from a collection point and deliver it to another sector. These items might have special conditions such as being fragile, perishable, sensitive to electric storms or oversized.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/1244bd58e1248f48212848a72cac796eadafaea1.jpg"]
RESTOCK REQUEST

Fulfill a request to deliver goods to a specified location. Players will need to gather these items ( via salvage or purchasing them at shops ) and take them to the specified delivery bay. Upon completion you will be reimbursed and paid a nice bonus!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/314d1804e46d0342c2c7f658b5e4f414cebf8022.jpg"]

It’s also worth noting that courier jobs have been designed to complement your travels while hauling and encourage a little bit of item hoarding. To account for that we’ve made sure the relevant jobs award a chunk more VXP than those in the Handyman venture.
UNLOCKABLE CAB CUSTOMIZATIONS
As with all business ventures, we’ve curated a large number of rewards for you to unlock as you progress through the ranks. Check out the image below for the entire collection in all its glory!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/deee7eb6e11fea671071f05b2f8996e514ea1b06.jpg"]
As mentioned earlier we’ve also brought together a premium pack of great value content as part of this update.

This DLC unlocks unique freight, trailers and corporations alongside a brand new business venture led by horticultural specialist Ada Greenway. It’s also packed with exclusive new cab customizations for you to unlock as you play.
Let’s take a look at all the cool content you get with this pack…
As part of this pack we’ve included a range of new freight for you to haul…
x3 Corporations - Fully branded companies tied in with the cultivation theme
x4 Trailer Types - New trailers for hauling a variety of cargo types
x10 Cargo Visuals - These are unique assets you’ll see in conjunction with the new trailers
X40 Cargo Contracts - These are effectively the types of cargo you haul (e.g. seeds are transported within a cargo pod or drum)
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/0ba30e1c7da089ac895e8c821514c80289ee2206.gif"]
Once unlocked the new trailers and cargo will be gradually added to the pool of available freight jobs. They can be easily spotted by their unique icon and colouring.
Keep in mind that, as with the base game, all new cargo has a variety of certifications requirements. The more certification skills you unlock the more cargo variety you will see!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/9491be2d13cde5942ac5df1c94c1adc1f5eee072.jpg"]
The Cultivation business venture will unlock shortly after you’ve gained access to the Handyman venture and performed some basic onboarding.
Ada Greenway, voiced by the wonderful Hannah Hebblethwaite, will then get in touch via the CB, offering a variety of contract work while she’s busy dealing with admin…
PRESSURE PURGE
Ada’s sensors sometimes indicate atmospheric issues with nearby biomes. You’ll need to head over and perform a manual purge to rebalance the dome.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/2ba7983e17f09a9d7db9de1e6a9fda129f7d422a.jpg"]
SHORT SURVEY
Sometimes real eyes are needed on a haul of crops. In these instances you’ll need to personally swing by and check domes for infestations, mould and other potential issues.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/7657b37b801d5cdfc6055c50d257b9806eba4c60.jpg"]
TEMPORARY TAPE
If a nearby biome is leaking atmosphere you’ll need to grab a roll of Flux Tape, head to the designated location and patch any cracks you can find.
BIOME BOOST
You might also receive a request to replace a dead Nutrient Canister at a nearby dome. Take a replacement and swap it out.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/d86b4eeb928d2a7063d36898a6008c4b8f8f9f0d.jpg"]

It’s also worth noting that as part of this update both Flux Tape and Nutrient Canisters are now available to purchase at most shops and garages around the galaxy. So if you plan to take on a lot of Cultivation jobs it’s a good idea to stock up whenever you get the chance!
As with the other ventures we have a whole set of themed cab customizations for you to unlock as you progress through your Cultivation Venture ranks.
Click the image below to view the entire set of rewards that are available as part of this pack…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/81f9c7c8ea3b0dbbd98886864dc3fbc3446b26bc.jpg"]
If you hadn’t guessed it, the Cultivation Content Pack is available right now and every sale helps support the continued development* of Star Trucker…
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3617450"]
* Bobble heads ain't cheap! - Dave
We covered some of this in our previous Dev Blog, but as a recap here’s some of the other bits n pieces you’ll find in this update…
Dock Shocks - Electrical storms will no longer affect your truck while docked
Switchin’ Up - New light switches allow you to toggle lights without the need to sit down
Zoom Toggle - We’ve added an option to allow players to toggle cab zoom on and off
Haunted Holo - A new seasonal hologram has been added for October
Big Drops - Extra locations added for picking up & delivering oversized freight across the galaxy
Venture Bonuses - Players are now reimbursed if a Venture job requires an item for completion
Radio Skits - x3 new in-world advertisement skits added to our pool of radio ads
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/62da1e05206ede3fcdcdb98a0aab0f85834b140f.gif"]
This has become a bit of a regular section for most Dev Blogs but for those new to Star Trucker we want you to know that you can submit feedback and report problems via the Raw Fury Support Portal.
This makes for happier Monsters as it allows us to easily collate community notes which in turn helps us fix issues faster, hopefully resulting in happier star truckers!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/556b8e0c695300c046055ea7babe7f25199ba48e.png"]

Firstly, we're gonna take a little break to recharge (it's been a fairly hot and hectic few months!) and then we're going to continue working on a quality of life update. This will include further adjustments to the job generator, balance tweaks, ux improvements, bug fixes and plenty of other goodies!
Until then, we hope you enjoy this update, and as always, thanks for supporting Star Trucker and taking the time to read another one of our rambling dev blogs ♥️
Dave & Dan ( aka Monster & Monster )

items.text: OVERVIEW
Hotfix for a couple of notable issues occurring in the latest update, alongside a little surprise 🦆
BUG FIXES
Fixed an issue where shops would refuse to buy your valuable ingots
Fixed an issue with a Broken Light job in Reaper’s Bluff, causing issues
Fixed an issue with Venture Screen occasionally misloading
Fixed an issue with the Dead Weight freight job not appearing until the Long Haul skill is unlocked
Fixed an issue where side job progression could stall if tutorial steps are skipped early on
MISC
Added a FREE trucker duck dashboard accessory
KNOWN ISSUES
For visibility, we have listed some of the issues we are currently tracking below. We will continue to work towards fixes for these in future updates.
Job Generator does not always provide a suitable selection of jobs
The menu system freaks out when certain peripherals are connected
Wall Panels don’t immediately apply materials when customizing the cab
A small number of players are experiencing unusual performance issues
As previously mentioned, the recent update touched on almost every element of the game and although we spent a lot of time, energy, and dollars testing, there are bound to be some niggles.

If you stumble on a particularly bad bug (or you just want to send some feedback), please head over to the Raw Fury Support Desk and submit a ticket. It makes it a lot easier for us to track and resolve issues this way. Thanks!
Dan & Dave ( aka Monster and Monster )
Howdy Star Truckers,
We’re back with a chunky dev blog to coincide with our largest update yet! There’s plenty to cover so let’s hit the gas and drive into things…
First up, our publisher Raw Fury has created a lovely little video for this update. Check it out below!
Secondly, interior customizations are finally here! You can now overhaul your cab interior with a range of options including new color schemes, dashboard items, wall panels and star strips.
You can access this menu by heading down to the lower workbench and interacting with the new board artwork.
The primary way to unlock customizations is by levelling up a Business Venture. However, we’ve also included a selection of items you can obtain via cash earned from hauling freight.
As more ventures come online, new rewards should always be within reach as you bounce between side jobs, freight hauls and helping out our new NPCs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/536ae4c29830a76f59bfbb1124ba7735b74bfc14.jpg"]
Here’s the current list of stuff you can modify within your cab…
Bedding - Different styles of bed and bedding
Cab Trim - Material used for paneling found inside the cab
Color Palettes - Colour themes that adjust the metals, plastics and other elements inside the cab.
Dash Lighting - Glowing elements such as neon strips and bulbs that fit around the front of the cab
Maglock Toppers - These attach to the maglock lever and come in a variety of shapes and styles
Star Strips - Decals that run along the top of the windscreen (both inside and out)
Space Suits - A variety of different outfits that have unique colours and patterns
Wall Panels - Changes the large panels found on the mezzanine and inside the airlock

Dash Accessories - We have two types of accessories. Dashboard items that can be placed in any (or all) of the four positions on the cab dash and Blower items that can be placed on either of the small vents. Some of these dash items are interactive and some blower items will animate at different speeds based on the blower power.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/f19c130c6f7195ae71a862a558e3b00a4c5d5ac1.jpg"]
We spoke a bit about Business Ventures in our previous blog post HERE but for those who want a general overview without dippin’ out of this post we’ve got you covered with a general overview below.
Unlock a Venture
Meet the requirements and you’ll get a holler from a new NPC and gain access to a unique set of jobs relating to that venture.
Complete Venture Jobs
Completing venture jobs will earn you VXP and level up the business.
Earn Rewards
For every level you complete you’ll earn new rewards! From colorful cab palettes and dashboard accessories to valuable items you can horde or sell to nearby traders.
Purchase Boosts
To aid progression, you can spend in-world cash on boosts to unlock extra job slots and increase the amount of VXP earned per job.
Clear Prestige Gates

Every 10 levels you’ll encounter prestige gates. Invest in the business to unlock these gates. Doing so will give you a bit more insight into the NPC you’re working with and allow you to continue taking jobs.
Max out your Venture Level
There’s plenty of levels to clear and 3 prestige gates to unlock. Clearing all of these is your primary goal for a Business Venture.
Venture Titles

After maxing out a Venture you have the opportunity to unlock a time limited title for bragging rights. This timer can be extended by continuing to take and complete venture jobs beyond the max level.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/91abff3a399d05694f79fe309341f585fdb92e3e.gif"]
It’s also worth noting that you can access the Venture screen at ANY TIME via a new tab in the game menu. Here you can take and cancel jobs or check progress towards your next goal.
We recommend taking Venture Jobs alongside freight hauls to maximize efficiency when navigating the galaxy. In fact this is part of the reason why job cooldowns and venture gates exist.
Venture jobs are intended to compliment the core gameplay loop and not supersede them.
Hop-timized
This update also rolls out improvements to the freight job generator. This includes…
Faster and more optimized job generation
More freight jobs visible on job boards
Fixing an issue with long distance jobs not always generating
Generally this should make the job boards feel a bit more reliable while also squashing some unwanted performance issues that could occur when hopping from sector to sector.
In future updates we’ll be looking to increase the number of local jobs, tweak XP payouts and hopefully inject some new job templates and cargo to help things feel a bit more varied.
Height Advantage
Another VERY important feature tucked away in this update is seat controls! Yes, that’s right, you can now adjust the height and position of your seat!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/385f81367a2aaa6b7cabbbb784b12f25835c9501.jpg"]

You can access these controls via the new buttons located on either side of the cab seats arm rests. Oh and we’ve also added these controls to the custom bindings screen. Handy for those who want to adjust their seat via a hot key!
It’s also worth noting that your seat position is saved per session so you’ll need to re-adjust if you start a new game or switch playthroughs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/8140e3b9d245cb8b8a33dd2b3c1466702d8e1d4a.gif"]
^ Here you can see the difference between positions and the affect it has on your forward view.
Lastly we also squashed a couple of long standing big ticket bugs as part of this update…
Rogue asteroids should no longer appear during warp preventing unexpected collisions
Your truck should no longer drift out of position when at a complete stop
Thanks for your patience while we dealt with these, both were quite difficult to reproduce and fix but should now be a thing of the past!
As you can imagine this update touches on almost every element of the game and although we’ve spent a lot of time, energy and dollar testing it there’s bound to be some niggles.

To that extent we’d like to remind you that if you stumble on a particularly bad bug (or you just want to send some feedback) please head over to the Raw Fury Support Portal and submit a ticker. It makes it a lot easier for us to track and resolve issues this way.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/556b8e0c695300c046055ea7babe7f25199ba48e.png"]
We’d also like to take a moment to thank those who helped contribute to this update. Without them we’d likely have taken many more months completing a fairly epic task list…
Alex P for dealing with all our 3D art demands. He’s made some awesome new artwork and has a ton of incredibly cool new stuff rolling out in the next couple of updates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/f707531f4771bb80e91966e809aa189dcfa5eeb2.gif"]
Darbotron for diving deep into the code base - squashing bugs and expanding our customization system
Nessa for the top notch new NPC dialogue (We’ll chat more on this in a future dev blog!)
Panda for developing a bunch of fictional graffiti artists alongside a stellar set of tags and dubs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/ab8a411fdd49cce1d2d4f249c1bae62d7ea2fdd6.jpg"]
Hanja and Dubravko at Fury Studios for their work on the new billboard designs and UI elements.
Ross for taking on the gruelling task of chopping up hours of VO sessions and labelling hundreds of audio files correctly.

We’d also like to give a special shoutout to our friend Kate! You don’t get too many opportunities to work with fabric designers when developing video games but she did a fantastic job on many of the bed patterns you’ll see in this and future updates.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232392/3d8b45ac5c434c50b139eae810f17cb00c467c0c.jpg"]
Lastly, a big thanks to all of you who’ve stuck around, providing feedback and sending us your support. It means the world to us and it’s the reason we do what we do ♥️

Rounding up this lengthy dev blog we wanted to let you know that we’ve got a great slate of ventures in the pipeline that we plan to roll out over the year. Each of these will feature a new character, jobs and variety of rewards. Maybe a handful of other surprises too!
We’ll be sure to talk more about all of those soon but in the meantime we hope you enjoy this update.
10-10 ‘til next we blog again!
Dave & Dan ( aka Monster & Monster )

items.text: Star Trucker has been updated to v1.0.72.2. This hotfix update resolves an issue that was causing major performance issues for some players.
HOTFIX
Resolved an issue with fuel signage generating excessive error logs that lead to performance issues on some device setups.
NOTES
This issue should not have affected those playing in locales that use decimal points for fractional values (such as the US, UK and China).

We’d like to apologise to those affected by this issue and thank you for your patience while we resolved the issue. If you find any further issues or oddities please let us know via the Raw Fury Support Desk and be sure to check the Latest News page for information on future patches and developer updates.
Dan & Dave ( aka Monster and Monster )
Star Trucker has been updated to v1.0.72.0. This update improves UI legibility for PC and handhelds (such as Steam Deck) while also addressing some quest bugs and other minor issues.

This will be set to “OFF” if not playing on a known handheld

Greetings Star Truckers!
The game has been updated to v1.0.41.0 bringing with it a range of bug fixes & balance tweaks. These should help provide a fairer and more consistent experience as you haul cargo across the stars.
Firstly we should mention that some of these fixes will only start to resolve themselves as you play. As existing jobs and cargo time out, newly generated jobs should behave as expected.

You will also notice that green and gold power cells that already exist in your cab will keep their existing charge despite an increase in capacity. However, any new power cells you find or buy will start at their new maximum capacity.

The last thing to note is that by fixing a bug in the reward calculations you will now receive higher cash payouts but less XP. We’ll keep an eye on how this plays out and if required work on a more nuanced economy and progression pass for a future update.

10-10 'til we do it again!
Dan & Dave ( aka Monster and Monster )
It’s been a week since launch and we just wanted to say thank you again for all the support and feedback we’ve been receiving from the Star Trucker community.
I know we talked a bit about priorities in the previous post but I thought it was worth diving a little deeper into what’s been going on and what the future holds for Star Trucker.
So I’m going to split this post into two parts. Firstly we’ll provide an overview of how we’re treating ongoing work and then I’ll go into a bit more detail regarding the next patch.

As you already know, we’re a super small team ( Currently 2.5 of us! ). We’re planning to ramp up by bringing on board some extra code support to help Dan but it will take time to finalize so we have to be super careful how we prioritise current and future work.
Knowing this we’ve tried to plan out some phases. We can’t give solid estimates but it should give you an idea of how we’ll tackle things going forwards.
It’s also worth noting that there might be multiple updates during a phase and some tasks could move around due to complexity and time scales.
Critical fixes (see the “Bugs” section below)
Difficulty tweaks - Focusing on essential items like power cells / air filters and revisiting fines
Custom key bindings
Extended controller support ( e.g. HOTAS )
Balance refinements - Focusing on economy, sector hazards and upgrades
Sector optimizations and updates
Online radio support
Corporation and cargo updates
Extended CB system (e.g. send out a recover SOS / ask for gossip)

We also have a couple of cosmetic packs already in the pipeline. These don’t require code support so shouldn’t delay new features / balance tasks but they are pretty cool ( I would say that though... ) and every sale will help fund future updates.
Beyond these phases we’ll begin work towards a longer roadmap with some more substantial feature / content work. Once we’ve locked down a plan we’ll be sure to update you all!
In the name of transparency we want to give you a slightly more detailed update on what’s been going on since launch / what we’re up to this week.
It’s kinda hard to break it down properly but hopefully this will give you an idea of where we are with the next update and the issues we’re currently trying to address.
Some of these have only been found thanks to the keen eyes of the community so please continue to report bugs to the Raw Fury Support Desk so that we can keep squashing them.
Many of these fixes should be in the next patch but a couple might slip to a subsequent update.
✅ Fixed an issue preventing saving after dying during warp
✅ Fixed an issue preventing warp gates working after a recovery
✅ Fixed an issue preventing access to x2 dropzones in Darkside
✅ Fixed an issue preventing access to a weigh station in Enigma Belt
✅ Fixed an issue where under some circumstances items vanish from containers on reload
✅ Fixed an issue with weigh stations ignoring your cargo capacity skill level
✅ Fixed various string issues
✅ Fixed an issue where some side jobs were not showing "Wait for CB Call" prompt on the Convoy screen
✅ Fixed issue with oversized Panel Trailers generating in multi-trailer jobs resulting in some drop zone deliveries being impossible
➡️ Fix an issue where the job board is not showing the correct reward values
➡️ Fix an issue where job rewards are not calculating correctly
➡️ Fix an issue with some dropzones thinking you can deliver oversized trailers to them
➡️ Fix an issue where under some circumstances the job board freezes
➡️ Fix an issue where reloading a save sometimes unhitches your trailers
➡️ Fix an issue where under specific conditions the mileage counter shows an incorrect value
We’re working on some initial balance adjustments to help make the game fairer and more consistent. A future update will focus on a more robust balance pass once we’ve collated more data.
✅ Increased frequency of essential items in shops ( e.g. power cells and air filters )
✅ Adjusted Power Cell costs and maximum charge levels
➡️ Adjust recovery penalties
➡️ Adjust abandoned job penalties
➡️ Adjust repair costs
Where possible we’ve also been chipping away at some other bits n pieces. Some of these are listed below…
✅ Electrical and Atmospheric Cloud optimizations
✅ Spark City Station and Tommy T Diner optimizations
✅ Various platform and girder LOD optimizations
✅ Updated Power Cell labels to reflect their quality ( e.g. Power Cell ++ )

So that’s the current situation! As you can see we’re working hard to improve player experience and address various issues. Not only that but an update is imminent, our team is expanding and we’re planning a LOT of great new stuff for the future.
So once again, thank you for your support and patience. We hope you’ll stick with us as we find a sustainable cadence for updates and begin working on new features and content.
Peace out.
Monster Dave
